# `unsorted-imports`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: idiomatic · Default: off · Fixes: quick fix · Options: none

Reports a safely reorderable top-level import block that is not grouped and
sorted by path.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Stable import order reduces merge conflicts and makes dependencies easier to
audit.

## When it fires

It applies only to contiguous, simple imports whose directly attached comments
can move with them unambiguously.

`std`, `builtin` and `root` come first, then package imports, then file
imports. A block is sorted when the first group is in the conventional order
`std`, `builtin`, `root` or in path order, and paths within a group compare
with or without case (`common.zig` before `FloatStream.zig`, or the reverse).
The fix writes the conventional order and compares paths without case.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");
const config = @import("config.zig");
const app = @import("app.zig");
```
